title: Project Arsenal Governance Source Model
description: Machine-readable index of where governance facts are owned and what state role each carrying artifact plays. This schema constrains the source model itself; it does NOT carry domain values such as supported targets, schema versions, adapter versions, suite IDs, or capability lifecycle/evaluation state. See scripts/arsenal_governance.py for the closed vocabularies referenced here.

id.description: Stable identifier for this artifact inside the source model. Used as the owner key for facts.

path.description: Repository-relative path to the artifact. Glob patterns are not allowed at the artifact level; use artifact_id_patterns to address a family of files.

path_pattern.description: Optional bounded glob pattern (e.g. 'arsenal/capabilities/*.json'). Repository-relative, no traversal. Used to address a family of artifacts that all share ownership and state role.

ownership.description: Closed ownership layer. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

state_role.description: Closed state role. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

materialization.description: Optional materialization mode. The validator rejects any value not in the canonical vocabulary.

owns_facts.description: Fact IDs whose normative source is this artifact. Empty array allowed only for narrative or derived artifacts that do not own any fact.

notes.description: Optional human-readable comment. The validator never reads this field for value assertions; it is purely documentation.

owner_artifact.description: The single artifact that owns this fact. Validation rejects a fact with more than one owner.

locator.description: Free-form locator inside the owner (e.g. 'lifecycle', 'targets', 'evaluation'). The validator may grep this string against the artifact body; it never carries the value itself.
